key_decisions: The two-stage mismatch was fixed IN THE NODE (ComfyUi-MpiNodes a6e5d5e), not by special-casing H3 in the app, so LTX, WAN and H3 keep ONE two-stage contract. MpiSaveLatent reports ui.latents; MpiLoadLatent checks engine input/ FIRST then falls back to <output>/latents/, which is what keeps a hand-run bench graph working unchanged.

The app engine was upgraded IN PLACE rather than by /engine/upgrade's full wipe. The portable ships ComfyUI as a git checkout (HEAD was exactly the pinned sha) and bundles its own update.py, so this is upstream-supported — ours checks out the PINNED sha, never pulls master. This also preserved the custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MpiNodes symlink, which the wipe would have replaced with a plain clone. Generalised as MPI-457.

Target is 0.30.0, not 0.30.2, because v0.30.1 and v0.30.2 are real upstream tags with NO Comfy-Org portable release. The 0.30.0->0.30.2 delta is frontend + cloud partner nodes + templates — nothing H3-relevant (H3 landed in 0.30.0 via 7dd46274 + 57500fc5).

H3 ships ONE workflow file with no _stage2 twin, the first model to do so. The lazy gates from MPI-449 make it possible, and it is the working precedent MPI-456 wants for LTX's six and WAN's two twins.
The ModelDef id is 'minimax-h3' because MPI-451's gate keys MODEL_LICENCES by model id. This was confirmed with that session by message before the def was written.

ref2va is a SEPARATE ModelDef 'minimax-h3-ref2va' (user decision). The MPI-451 session has ALREADY added its MODEL_LICENCES key pointing at the same descriptor — do not add it again; licences.js is their file.

capabilities.audio is deliberately OFF on a model that outputs audio. That flag surfaces an audio INPUT slot + audioMode/useAudio controls; fl2va accepts no audio, it only emits it muxed into the mp4. ref2va DOES take audio in and wants audio: true.
The card preview is this session's own test render. Real H3 output so it does not misrepresent the model, but it is 56 frames — below the trained range — and a 'neon-lit street' test prompt.
constraints: ACCEPTANCE RECEIPTS ARE KEYED BY LICENCE ID, NOT MODEL ID. Accepting while installing fl2va ALSO satisfies ref2va, so the second install shows NO dialog. That is deliberate (the licence binds the person), not a leak — do not 'fix' it. localStorage key is mpi_model_licence_accepted, receipt keyed 'minimax-h3-cla-2026-08-02', and it carries acceptedVia. Clear that key to force the dialog back.

NOTHING IS ON R2 AND NOTHING MAY BE. The H3 licence grants rights only outside the EU/UK/USA/South Korea and its trigger covers distribution; pointing deps at Comfy-Org and ethanfel removes the clearest claim. This is what was told to MiniMax. Do not 'fix' a publisher URL by re-hosting.

Injection SILENTLY SKIPS an Input_* title that matches no node — no error, no warning. On H3 the failure mode is a plausible WRONG VIDEO, because routing derives from media presence rather than an op int.
The app does NOT prune muted nodes; the ComfyUI browser DOES. A bench-authored graph can depend on that difference — it is how this class of bug was missed on WAN.

The word 'audio' in a latent node TITLE is load-bearing: _latentRoleFromTitle tags any title containing it as the audio latent. The pair must stay Output_Video_Latent / Input_Video_Latent. generate_h3.py asserts this.

NEVER hand-edit a workflow JSON. The generator is the sanctioned place to normalise — it already bakes Input_Start_Frame/Input_End_Frame empty, the stage flags false, and the canvas to 864x480, because the export carried Input_End_Frame="d" which feeds has_img2.
tqdm prints each FINISHED bar twice, so a raw grep of '100%' lines doubles the bar count. Count distinct bars when re-measuring progressStages.
H3 frame counts are n % 17 == 5 at 24 fps; trained range is 124-362 frames. A 2 s request yields 56 frames, which WORKS but is below the trained range.

very_high (1088x1920) is a FINAL-RENDER tier, not an iterate tier: 2x pixels costs 3.3x time. A canvas change is a different latent shape, so the same seed is a DIFFERENT sample — a tier A/B is never 'same shot, sharper'.

Bench is port 8188 (v0.30.2, G:/ComfyUi); the APP engine is 48188 (now v0.30.0). Do not confuse them. Leaving a manual engine running on 48188 makes the app fail to start with 'port already in use' — that happened this session.
A Diffusers-format H3 LoRA loads with NO ERROR and does nothing — model_lora_keys_unet has no H3 branch. Only diffusion_model.* / lora_unet_* keys map.
MPI-451 runs in a PARALLEL session and owns js/data/modelConstants/licences.js and js/services/downloadService.js. Do not edit those; message the card instead.
Git Bash mangles a bare /FLAG into C:/Program Files/Git/FLAG and the shell can still exit 0 — a 53GB robocopy move copied NOTHING and read as success. Use PowerShell for Windows-native tools.
